name: Blood Feud
description: Your beef isn't just battle rap anymore. Your rival is taking things personal, and it's spilling into real life.

chapters.title: Beyond the Battle
chapters.description: Your rival posted about you. Not battle rap stuff - personal attacks. Your family, your past, things that should be off-limits. The comments are going crazy.

choices.label: Fire Back
choices.description: Match their energy. Air them out too.

choices.label: Don't Respond
choices.description: Don't give them the satisfaction. Stay silent.

choices.label: Reach Out Directly
choices.description: Call them. Handle this man to man.

chapters.title: Social Media War
chapters.description: It's all out war online. Every day there's new posts, new diss tracks previewed, people picking sides. The culture is watching.

choices.label: Keep It Going
choices.description: You're winning this war. Don't stop now.

choices.label: Demand the Battle
choices.description: Enough talking. Let's settle this on stage.

choices.label: Walk It Back
choices.description: This is getting out of control. De-escalate.

chapters.title: They Keep Coming
chapters.description: Your silence is being read as weakness. They're doubling down, and now other people are joining in. The pile-on is real.

choices.label: Break Your Silence
choices.description: Enough. Time to respond.

choices.label: Stay Above It
choices.description: Let them talk. Actions speak louder.

chapters.title: The Conversation
chapters.description: You reached out. The conversation was heated but you both aired your grievances. They agreed to delete the post if you squash the beef publicly.

choices.label: Squash It Publicly
choices.description: Shake hands online. Move on.

choices.label: Want More
choices.description: They need to apologize properly. Publicly.

chapters.title: Boiling Point
chapters.description: You're both at the same event. The tension is palpable. Everyone's watching to see what happens when you cross paths.

choices.label: Confront Them
choices.description: Walk up. Say what needs to be said.

choices.label: Avoid Contact
choices.description: Not here. Not like this.

chapters.title: The Challenge
chapters.description: You called for the battle. The leagues are interested - this beef would bring huge numbers. Your rival accepted. It's happening.

choices.label: Prepare Like Never Before
choices.description: This is personal. Leave nothing in the tank.

choices.label: Play It Cool
choices.description: Don't overthink it. You know what to do.

chapters.title: Setting the Record Straight
chapters.description: You finally responded - not with insults, but with facts. The truth about who started this, what really happened, and what you're about.

choices.label: Offer to Battle
choices.description: Let's settle this the right way.

choices.label: Leave It There
choices.description: You said your piece. Let the people decide.

chapters.title: Pride on the Line
chapters.description: They're refusing to apologize publicly. Claims it would make them look weak. The deal is falling apart.

choices.label: Accept Private Resolution
choices.description: Fine. As long as they stop.

choices.label: Back to War
choices.description: If they won't apologize, this isn't over.

chapters.title: Face to Face
chapters.description: You're face to face with your rival. Cameras are out. Everyone's watching. Words are exchanged. It could go either way.

choices.label: Keep It Verbal
choices.description: Say what you need to say. Nothing more.

choices.label: Walk Away
choices.description: You've said enough. Don't give them more.

choices.label: Things Get Physical
choices.description: Sometimes words aren't enough...

endings.title: The Showdown
endings.description: The battle is set. The biggest grudge match in recent memory. Win or lose, you handled this the right way - on stage, bars for bars.

endings.title: Squashed Beef
endings.description: You handled it like adults. The beef is over, mutual respect established. The culture appreciates you both for not letting it get ugly.

endings.title: Above the Drama
endings.description: You never engaged. Let them look like the aggressor while you stayed focused on your craft. The high road isn't always satisfying, but you kept your dignity.

endings.title: Verbal Victory
endings.description: Face to face, you said what needed to be said. Everyone saw it - you won that exchange without throwing a punch. That's how it's done.

endings.title: Statement Made
endings.description: You set the record straight. The truth is out there now. Whether people believe you or not is on them.

endings.title: Quiet Resolution
endings.description: It's over, quietly. No public handshake, no announcement - just an understanding that it stops here.

endings.title: Walked Away
endings.description: You walked away from the confrontation. Some call it smart, some call it soft. You know what it took to not react.

endings.title: Backed Down
endings.description: You tried to de-escalate but it looked like backing down. The narrative is set - they won this round.

endings.title: Avoided
endings.description: You avoided the confrontation. People noticed. Some respected it, most didn't. The beef continues to simmer.

endings.title: Things Got Physical
endings.description: It went too far. Now there are videos, possibly legal consequences, definitely career damage. This is not how battle rappers should handle beef.
